purpose: Level 2 STRUCTURAL: bounded sample of ONE real record from the site's own public JSON API (https://www.southlandsarts.co.uk/wp-json/geodir/v2/events), showing the full field shape available -- title, slug, link, start/end date+time, price, ticket_link, post_category, and a stable numeric id. method: curl -sS -L -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; BandOnTheMapResearch/1.0; +research)' --max-time 20 (single unauthenticated GET; no retries); the one record below was selected from that real retained response (the WordPress post_type=gd_event record for 'Classic Concert', the only Music-tagged event found).
